# Old Man by the Crib

The cursed beer presses hard on my bladder here,  
And I know myself, I must draw near;  
The line is long - reaching to the door  
But determined I stand, I won’t waste more.  
Struggling, I gather my will once again  
And aim for the stream just over the fen;  
Around me the fellows are splashing in glee,  
I "squeeze a kidney" and soak my shoes free.
